definitions.gloss: chin beard; goatee; beard on the chin
definitions.explanation: Facial hair growing on the chin. Can refer to any beard on the chin area, including a goatee.

examples.japanese: あごひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|は}やす→生やす：02399_hayasu⟧。
⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧なあごひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蓄|たくわ}えた→蓄える：08996_takuwaeru⟧⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{座|すわ}っていた→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: An old man with a splendid beard was sitting there.

notes:
Compound of あご (chin/jaw) + ⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧ (facial hair). Also written {顎鬚|あごひげ} or {顎髭|あごひげ} in kanji, though the kana spelling is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あごひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|は}やす→生やす：02399_hayasu⟧: to grow a chin beard
- あごひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧: to shave one's beard
- あごひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蓄|たくわ}える→蓄える：08996_takuwaeru⟧: to grow/keep a beard (literary)
- あごひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to trim one's beard

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧: facial hair (general term) — can refer to any facial hair
- {口|くち}ひげ: mustache — hair above the upper lip
- ほおひげ: sideburns — hair on the cheeks
